source_prose: On the far bank, a rain-worn wooden shelter stands against the forest. Inside there is a long oak bench resting on the floor. A small beeswax candle stands on the bench in a metal holder. A clay water jug rests on the ground beside the bench. A handwritten note lies on the bench. It warns that the old woods are vulnerable to fire. The scene should feel like an abandoned but believable place.
